warnings.desc: Severe thunderstorms are likely to produce damaging winds, large hailstones and heavy rainfall that may lead to flash flooding in the warning area over the next several hours. Locations which may be affected include Ali Curung, Ampilatwatja and Barkly District east of Tennant Creek. Severe thunderstorms are no longer occurring in the Tanami district and the warning for this district is CANCELLED.
